title: Surveys & Related Lists
blurb: A survey, review or related list. Read one first to place the rest in context.

title: Foundations & Prehistory
blurb: Work that defined the problem before interactive video world models were a category of their own: latent world models, neural game engines, playable video generation.

title: Blogs & Technical Reports
blurb: No paper — announced through a blog post or technical report, documented well enough to place. Every URL carrying this tag has been checked by hand.

title: Interactive Video World Models
blurb: Meets all three scope criteria: per-step action conditioning, causal or streaming generation, persistent world state. The strict bar, and the only tag that feeds the comparison table.

title: Action Control & Interfaces
blurb: How an action reaches the generator: action spaces, injection mechanisms, latent actions learned without labels, control-fidelity analysis. A prompt issued per step, per entity or mid-rollout is an action too, so language interfaces carry this tag alongside the ones about buttons.

title: Real-Time & Streaming Generation
blurb: Meeting the per-frame latency budget: causal and autoregressive backbones, few-step distillation, KV caching, inference systems.

title: Long-Horizon Memory & Consistency
blurb: Keeping the world stable when the camera comes back: long context, explicit spatial and 3D memory, retrieval, state persistence.

title: Benchmarks & Evaluation
blurb: A benchmark or evaluation protocol aimed at interactive world models — memory, control-following, long-horizon stability.

title: Datasets & Environments
blurb: An action-annotated video corpus or a simulator used to train and probe interactive world models.
